map.→ 打开水泵扬程计算工具: -> Open the pump head calculator tool
map.变频恒压供水选泵与运行点。: Variable-frequency constant-pressure water supply: pump selection and operating point.
map.吸上高度加损失不超过允许汽蚀余量，必要时降安装高度或换首级叶轮。: The suction head plus losses must not exceed the allowable cavitation margin; lower the installation height or change the first-stage impeller if needed.
map.吸上高度校核汽蚀余量。: Check the suction head against the cavitation margin.
map.填写「压水局部系数 Σζd」。: Fill in "pressure-side local loss coefficient Σζd".
map.填写「吸水局部系数 Σζs」。: Fill in "suction-side local loss coefficient Σζs".
map.扬程和流量谁先定？: Which comes first, head or flow rate?
map.按几何高差加管路损失定泵扬程。: Set the pump head from the geometric head plus the pipe losses.
map.流量由工艺定，扬程由几何高差与阻力定，二者交点即选泵依据。: The flow rate is set by the process and the head by the geometric height plus resistance; the intersection of the two is the basis for pump selection.
map.管道沿程水头损失: Friction head loss along a pipe
map.输入吸水管与压水管路的几何高差、沿程与局部水头损失，计算水泵所需总扬程，用于清水: Enter the geometric head difference of the suction and pressure pipework plus the friction and local head losses to compute the total pump head, which sets the head parameter when selecting a pump for a clean-water or drainage system and avoids undersizing that would leave the supply short.
map.：总扬程 H = 3（吸程）+ 25（几何）+ 5（损失，含裕量）≈ 33 m，: : the total head H = 3 (suction) + 25 (geometric) + 5 (losses, including margin) ≈ 33 m; use it to pick the operating point on the pump curve.
map.：管路损失从 5 增至 10 m，泵工作点左移流量降，需重选或放大管径。: : increasing the pipe loss from 5 to 10 m moves the pump operating point left and lowers the flow, so a re-selection or a larger diameter is needed.
